data.narrative:
Kvertus is a growth-stage Defense & Security company founded by Yaroslav Filimonov and Andrii Znaichenko, currently raising on ~$130M total capital raised to date. The Defense & Security sector comprises a comp universe of 2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private peers, including Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, Saronic, and Quantum-Systems.

The peer-median method is not applicable to this valuation. A rigorous narrow-peer screen filtered for same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-valuation-tier comparables within Defense & Security yielded fewer than three datapoints—the minimum threshold for reliable triangulation. While 21 same-sector peers exist in the broader Defense & Security universe, none satisfied the stringent criteria required to construct a defensible comp multiple. Expanding the screen to all-sector medians would introduce unacceptable sector heterogeneity and render results unreliable.

Without sufficient narrow-peer density to support peer-median methodology, traditional multiples-based valuation is not supported by the available data. Alternative approaches—such as discounted cash flow analysis or precedent transaction review within the narrowly-defined Defense & Security growth-stage cohort—would require financial and M&A data not present in this dataset. The key uncertainty remains the scarcity of traded or recently-valued comparable companies at Kvertus's stage and within its specific sector focus. Further diligence on the capital efficiency and growth trajectory of the five identified private peers may inform directional valuation bounds, pending access to their underlying financials.
